item.description: title: “Project List” date: 2025-12-03T23:01:00-05:00 draft: false Selected Projects This document outlines several completed and ongoing technical and creative projects. Modified “Turing Test” with an English Focus The goal of this project is to both inform about and assess Generative AI’s ability to participate in creative writing and compare its output to that created by humans. The assessment is conducted via a modified “Turing Test” to see if readers are able to differentiate between human and AI writers.
